checks.name: Backend verify incl. CookWorkflowIntegrationTest and ContractRoutesTest
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity

scenarios.observed: CookWorkflowIntegrationTest on PostgreSQL: an account with no application, an incomplete application (422 with REQUIRED/PICKUP_OR_ZONE_REQUIRED field errors, no revision) or one under review, changes-requested or rejected has no kitchen, so KitchenDirectory.ownedBy is empty and nothing can sell; only APPROVE by a cook.review holder with recent MFA creates the kitchen (canSell true). Rejected and changes-requested revisions keep their snapshot, decision, reason, reviewer and time; database triggers reject rewriting or deleting them. Meal publication (MB-014) and order acceptance (MB-019) do not exist yet and must call KitchenDirectory; they are re-tested there.

Ops PAUSE makes canSell false while canAcceptOrders and canFulfillAcceptedOrders stay true; SUSPEND makes canSell and canAcceptOrders false while canFulfillAcceptedOrders stays true; the public profile reports available=false; the application stays APPROVED (operating state separate); RESTORE returns to selling; every change is audited. The cook cannot change state through ops (403), staff cannot change their own kitchen (403, audited), no-MFA is STEP_UP_REQUIRED. A mutation letting suspended kitchens accept orders made the test fail. Discovery/checkout/fulfilment views (MB-016/017/019) must use this policy and will be re-tested there.

Only scoped reviewers can decide: customers, finance.read staff, unauthenticated callers and reviewers without recent MFA are refused with no state change; self-review is 403 and audited (mutation removing the check made the test fail); incomplete applications cannot be submitted (mutation removing a required field check failed the test); stale revision/version, missing reason, missing Idempotency-Key and skipping UNDER_REVIEW are refused; idempotent replay returns the same result, key reuse with another body is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, and four concurrent approvals create exactly one kitchen and one approval audit. Private location and contact never appear in the queue or public profile; reviewer detail reads are audited. Registry implemented flags equal the served /api routes (mutation detected).

findings: Self-review: idempotency records would survive a failed command when the caller does not roll back; failed commands now delete their record, and self-review denial runs in a separate transaction so its audit survives while the decision rolls back normally.
Self-review: server Idempotency-Key charset aligned to the contract pattern; queue default limit aligned to 20; q search escapes LIKE wildcards (tested).

Residual: private application documents (upload, expiring reviewer access) are not implemented; they depend on media (MB-013) and on the required-document policy (O06). Completeness currently covers profile, contact, location and serviceability only.
Residual: REJECTED is final (no reapplication) pending O06; cook self-pause (CK09) and affected-order review on suspension arrive with the cook workspace and orders.
Residual: reviewer step-up relies on provider MFA claims; a real OTP login in local Keycloak is still not configured (carried from MB-011).
